# Import

```{r}

# ============================================== #
# table data
studyarea <- readxl::read_xlsx(in1, sheet = "20261103_studyarea")





# ============================================== #
# import polygon

# list all shapefiles
shp_files <- list.files(
  in2,
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE, 
  recursive = FALSE
)


# view file names
basename(shp_files)

# read all shapefiles
shp_list <- shp_files |>
  setNames(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(shp_files))) |>
  map(read_sf)



# ============================================== #
# import cleaned reviewdata table

rt_table <- readr::read_csv(
  here("result", "reviewtable_organize", "rt_table.csv")
)


# ============================================== #
# import cleaned species reviewdata table

rt_species <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here("data", "20261103_ER_reviewtable_cleaning.xlsx"),
  sheet = "dataentry_editing")
colnames(rt_species) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(rt_species))
rt_species$Magnitude_of_shift = as.numeric(rt_species$Magnitude_of_shift)

```


# Create statistical results for popups

```{r}
library(base64enc)

# ============================================== #
### create class color list

# Extract unique classes
class_color_table <- data.frame(
  Class = sort(unique(na.omit(rt_species$Class)))
)

# Assign random colors
set.seed(123)

class_color_table$Color <- sample(
  hcl.colors(nrow(class_color_table), palette = "Dark 3")
)

class_palette <- setNames(
  class_color_table$Color,
  class_color_table$Class
)

# ============================================== #
### function

make_popup <- function(title, fig) {

  # temperately save ggplot as PNG
  img_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = img_file,
    plot = fig,
    width = 5,
    height = 3,
    dpi = 120,
    bg = "white"
  )

  # transfer plot into Base64
  img_src <- base64enc::dataURI(
    file = img_file,
    mime = "image/png"
  )

  unlink(img_file)

  # create HTML popup
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    "<div style='width:450px;'>",
    "<h3>", htmltools::htmlEscape(title), "</h3>",
    "<img src='", img_src,
    "' style='width:100%;height:auto;'>",
    "</div>"
  ))
}


# ============================================== #
### work place

rt_sp_shp = rt_species %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Position),
    !is.na(Class),
    !is.na(Magnitude_of_shift)
  ) %>% 
  filter(Reference_no == studyarea2$reference_no[1])%>%
  mutate(
    Position = as.character(Position),
    Class = as.character(Class)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Position) %>%
  arrange(Magnitude_of_shift, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(bar_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

position_order <- c("Trailing", "Centroid", "Leading")

# Automatically detect available positions
positions <- c(
  intersect(position_order, unique(rt_sp_shp$Position)),
  setdiff(unique(rt_sp_shp$Position), position_order)
)

# Common Y-axis limits
y_limits <- range(c(0, rt_sp_shp$Magnitude_of_shift))

# Classes appearing in the current subset
used_classes <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(rt_sp_shp$Class))))

# Extract corresponding colors from the master palette
plot_palette <- class_palette[used_classes]

# ========================================
# plot

create_shift_plot <- function(pos) {

  data_sub <- rt_sp_shp %>%
    filter(Position == pos)

  ggplot(
    data_sub,
    aes(
      x = bar_id,
      y = Magnitude_of_shift,
      fill = Class
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(width = 1, show.legend = TRUE) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = plot_palette,
      limits = used_classes,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = NULL,
      expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(pos, ", N = ", nrow(data_sub)),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Latitudinal shift (km/year)",
      fill = "Class"
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# ========================================
# 4. Generate plots 

plot_list <- lapply(positions, create_shift_plot)

names(plot_list) <- positions


# ========================================
# 5. Combine plots into 1 x n layout

combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  plot_list,
  nrow = 1,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

combined_plot



# ========================================
# Popup

popup1 <- make_popup(
  title = names(shp_list)[1],
  fig = combined_plot
)

```



# Basic flow

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: false

# names(shp_list)
# names(shp_list)[1]
# plot(shp_list[[1]])


# ============================================== #
# define colors for polygons

polygon_colors <- grDevices::hcl.colors(
  length(shp_list),
  palette = "Dark 3"
)

# ============================================== #
# map on leaflet

m_example <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>% # Add default OpenStreetMap map tiles
  setView(lng = 138.040, lat = 36.140, zoom = 4) %>% 
  addMarkers(lng = 141.34144193866803, lat = 43.070559674088784, 
             popup = "Hokudai") #%>% 
  # addPolygons(data = shp_list[[1]],
  #             color = "blue", stroke = 0.1, opacity = 0.8,
  #             popup = popup1) 

for (i in seq_along(shp_list)) {

  m_example <- m_example %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = shp_list[[i]],
      color = polygon_colors[i],
      stroke = TRUE,
      weight = 1,
      opacity = 0.8,
      popup = rep(
        popup1,
        nrow(shp_list[[i]])
      )
    )
}

m_example


# ============================================== #
# export as self contained html

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  m_example,
  file = here(dir_out, "map_example_selfcont.html"),
  selfcontained = TRUE
)


```




# Edit data

```{r}

# names(shp_list)
# names(shp_list)[1]
# plot(shp_list[[1]])

# ============================================== #
# edit reviewtable data

rt_distinct <- rt_table %>% 
  distinct(index, reference_no, publication_id)



studyarea2 <- studyarea %>% 
  select(-index) %>%
  filter(memo == "use")


# ============================================== #
# join study area data to review table

rt_distinct2 <- rt_distinct %>%
  left_join(
    studyarea2,
    by = "reference_no"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shp_name = tools::file_path_sans_ext(file_final),
    shp = shp_list[shp_name]
  )


# ============================================== #
# prepare polygon data for leaflet

studyarea_cleaned <- rt_distinct2 %>%
  group_by(shp_name) %>%
  summarise(
    realm = first(realm),
    index = paste(
      sort(unique(index)),
      collapse = "<br>"
    ),
    publication_id = paste(
      sort(unique(publication_id)),
      collapse = "<br>"
    ),
    shp = list(shp[[1]]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    area = purrr::map_dbl(
      shp,
      ~ as.numeric(sum(sf::st_area(.x)))
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(realm, desc(area)) %>%
  
  # assign colors separately within each realm
  group_by(realm) %>%
  mutate(
    color = case_when(
      realm == "marine" ~ grDevices::hcl.colors(
        n(),
        palette = "Blues 3"
      ),
      realm == "terrestrial" ~ grDevices::hcl.colors(
        n(),
        palette = "YlOrRd"
      )
      
      # realm == "marine" ~ grDevices::hcl.colors(
      #   n(),
      #   palette = "BluGrn"
      # ),
      # 
      # realm == "terrestrial" ~ grDevices::hcl.colors(
      #   n(),
      #   palette = "OrRd"
      # )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



# ============================================== #
# export polygon color codes

# non-expanded:
# one row per polygon, publication_ids combined with <br>
studyarea_color <- studyarea_cleaned %>%
  select(
    index,
    shp_name,
    realm,
    publication_id,
    color
  )

readr::write_csv(
  studyarea_color,
  file.path(dir_out, "studyarea_color.csv")
)


# expanded:
# one row per publication_id
studyarea_color_expanded <- studyarea_color %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    index,
    publication_id,
    sep = "<br>"
  )

readr::write_csv(
  studyarea_color_expanded,
  file.path(dir_out, "studyarea_color_expanded.csv")
)
```






# Visualize

```{r}
# ============================================== #
# map on leaflet

m <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  setView(
    lng = 138.040,
    lat = 36.140,
    zoom = 4
  )

m <- purrr::reduce(
  seq_len(nrow(studyarea_cleaned)),
  function(map, i) {

    map %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = studyarea_cleaned$shp[[i]],
        color = studyarea_cleaned$color[i],
        weight = 2,
        opacity = 1,
        fillColor = studyarea_cleaned$color[i],
        fillOpacity = 0.3,
        popup = studyarea_cleaned$publication_id[i]
      )
  },
  .init = m
)

m


```
